items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: I guess it was Teagarden's band.

ctx.x: I just wondered about the clarinet. Yes, well, um...

I guess it was Teagarden's band. It was Teagarden's band, yes. I looked it up particularly because I was interested. I remembered that, uh, that was the first time I could have heard any jazz and, uh, appreciated it.
Well, you found other friends who were interested in that.
